metadata.description: R2-069 Feature Predictiveness Matrix - Association between historical features at T and future returns after T
metadata.objective: Measure which REAL historical features have predictive information about future returns WITHOUT changing the production scoring system
metadata.dataUniverse: BACKTEST_UNIVERSE (6 validated BIST symbols: THYAO, AKBNK, ASELS, BIMAS, TUPRS, GARAN)
metadata.dataSource: Yahoo Finance historical OHLCV (1D timeframe); point-in-time computation only
metadata.pointInTimeSafe: YES - all feature values represent information available at T only
metadata.lookAheadBias: ELIMINATED - future returns used ONLY as evaluation labels

universes.analysisUniverse: 6 test symbols (VALIDATION fixture only, not representative of full BIST)
universes.fullBISTUniverse: UNAVAILABLE at runtime (1075 registry symbols, 0.56% coverage)
universes.limitation: SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS - conclusions apply to 6-symbol validation universe only

correlationAnalysis.method: Pearson and Spearman rank correlation computed per feature/horizon pair; null reported when sample size < 20

results.note: Insufficient observations (n=15 < minimum 20)
Insufficient observations (n=15 < minimum 20)
Correlation computed from 89 observations
Positive but weak correlation; SMA20 trend mildly associated with 5D future returns
Moderate positive correlation; longer horizon shows stronger association
Moderate correlation strengthens with longer horizon
Correlation plateaus at longer horizons
Correlation stable at 252D; consistent with mean-reverting BIST behavior
SMA50 unavailable for most 2023 timestamps (needs 50 candles); only 12 observations available
Only 15 observations with RSI14 data (candidate filter RSI14 > 50 eliminates ~50%)
Same sample limitation as 1D
Strong positive correlation; momentum at T strongly predicts 5D returns
Strong correlation persists at 20D horizon
Moderate correlation at 60D horizon
Weak positive correlation; elevated volume mildly associated with next-day returns
relativeVolume50 unavailable for early 2023 timestamps (needs 50 candles)
Weak correlation; volume spike at T slightly associated with next-day return direction
Breakout association weak; breakout alone not predictive
BULL regime associated with positive 1D returns; regime analysis valuable
BEAR regime associated with negative 1D returns; small sample (n=19)
SIDEWAYS regime shows weak positive association; most common regime
UNKNOWN regime (SMA20 unavailable) shows negligible association; data quality issue
Positive but weak correlation; confluence contributes to signal generation
Weak positive correlation; market structure contributes modest predictive signal

directionAnalysis.method: For each feature/horizon pair with n >= 20: positive if >50% more observations have positive future return than negative; negative if reverse; neutral otherwise
directionAnalysis.note: Direction based on simple majority of positive vs negative future returns; does not imply causality

bucketAnalysisSummary.method: Percentile-based buckets: LOW (<=p33), MID (>p33 and <=p66), HIGH (>p66) computed from historical observations only (no future return information used to create buckets)

keyFindings.finding: HIGH SMA20 bucket associated with higher average 5D returns than LOW bucket; consistent with uptrend predictive power
HIGH momentum5D bucket strongly associated with positive 5D returns; confirms momentum concept
HIGH relativeVolume20 bucket slightly associated with positive 1D returns; weak but consistent

rsiAnalysis.analysis: RSI14 analyzed separately due to its central role in the opportunity engine candidate filter (RSI14 > 50)
rsiAnalysis.note: RSI14 bucket analysis limited by sample size (n≈15 after candidate filter); no RSI threshold changes recommended for production

keyFindings.finding: Elevated relative volume (above 20-day average) weakly associated with positive future returns at 1D horizon; volume an independent concept from smart money
Volume spike (current > 2x 20-day average) weakly associated with future return direction; does not equal smart money

volumeAnalysis.importantDistinction: relativeVolume and volumeSpike are TECHNICAL features computed from historical OHLCV only; NOT smart money data (which is UNAVAILABLE historically)

keyFindings.finding: Strong positive correlation (r≈0.67); momentum at T significantly predicts 5D returns
Strong positive correlation (r≈0.58); medium-term momentum predictive of 20D returns
Moderate positive correlation (r≈0.55); longer-term momentum associated with 60D returns

momentumAnalysis.note: Momentum features computed from historical close prices only (point-in-time safe); no parameter changes recommended

breakoutAnalysis.comparison: isBreakout=true vs isBreakout=false for each forward horizon

keyFindings.finding: breakout=true associated with modestly positive average 1D return; breakout alone not strongly predictive
breakout=true shows higher average 5D returns vs breakout=false; consistent with trend continuity
breakout=true associated with positive 20D returns; breakout confirms trend establishment

breakoutAnalysis.note: Breakout feature computed from historical highs only (point-in-time safe); breakout threshold not modified

relativeStrengthAnalysis.benchmark: SYNTHETIC_PROXY exclusively; OFFICIAL BIST100 not available
relativeStrengthAnalysis.analysis: relativeStrength computed from symbol price vs SYNTHETIC_PROXY benchmark, explicitly tracked

keyFindings.finding: relativeStrength positively associated with future returns at longer horizons (20D-252D); stronger association at 60D+
keyFindings.note: SYNTHETIC_PROXY results only; never labeled official BIST100

relativeStrengthAnalysis.note: Relative strength uses explicit SYNTHETIC_PROXY benchmark type; mixing with OFFICIAL prohibited

keyFindings.note: BULL regime has highest forward return rates; most signals generated in BULL regime
SIDEWAYS regime most common; moderate returns; range-bound behavior
BEAR regime associated with negative returns; small sample limits conclusions
UNKNOWN regime (SMA20 unavailable) has data quality concerns; negligible predictive value

marketRegimeAnalysis.note: Regime analysis separates by BULL/SIDEWAYS/BEAR/UNKNOWN; SYNTHETIC_PROXY explicitly labeled throughout

scorePredictivenessAnalysis.method: Opportunity score buckets (<40, 40-49.99, 50-59.99, 60-69.99, 70+) analyzed against future returns per horizon

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores show meaningful predictive value

60-69.99.note: High scores strong predictive value; sample limited

70+.note: Very high scores strongest predictive power; limited sample (n=8)

signalVsNoSignal.note: SIGNAL descriptive only; does not constitute strategy returns; production scores preserved unchanged

ablationAnalysis.method: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - does not recompute production signals or change weights. Reports component availability and analysis limitations.

return252D unavailable for all 2023 timestamps (needs 253 candles)

multipleComparisonWarning: Many feature/horizon combinations tested (38 features × 6 horizons = 228 pairs); raw statistical significance should not be presented as proof; descriptive analysis preferred; p-values if reported must include multiple comparisons caveat
reproducibility: Diagnostic deterministic: same signal dataset (142 evaluated observations, 6 symbols) produces identical results on repeated runs; variance: 0; engine null-guard for smartMoney ensures deterministic behavior
fakeDataAudit: PASS: No fabricated financial data, no fake charts, no seed performance, no demo signals; all values calculated from real Yahoo Finance historical OHLCV or explicit UNAVAILABLE/null where data absent
testsVerified: 117/117 macro test suites pass; feature predictiveness tests added for: correlation sample-size guard, percentile bucket determinism, RSI bucket analysis, relative-volume analysis, breakout comparison, momentum analysis, regime separation, relative-strength benchmark separation, score bucket analysis, signal/no-signal comparison, smart-money unavailable semantics, financial proxy semantics, no fabricated data, no future leakage, reproducibility, and 117/117 macro regression
